verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents an official Python SDK for partitioning, enrichment, chunking and embedding, and for managing workflows. Python quickstarts also cover extract jobs. The evidence never mentions a TypeScript SDK, never claims the SDK is typed, and does not show the Python SDK covering the job APIs or describe its defaults. missing for 10: official TypeScript SDK, evidence of typed interfaces, explicit SDK coverage of job tracking and control, documentation of sensible defaults, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, official typed SDKs for Python and TypeScript cover the full API — parse, extract, jobs — with sensible defaults

citations.quote: The Unstructured Python SDK enables you to call the Unstructured API with standard Python code to partition, enrich, chunk, and embed your files.
Build and manage Unstructured workflows with the Python SDK or REST endpoints.
Use Python or cURL to turn local files into AI-ready JSON.
Create a job to extract only the data that you care about from your documents
